name: Immich Photo Management System
description: Installs Immich as the sovereign family photo archive on Arcturus. Provides self-hosted Google Photos replacement with web UI, mobile apps, face recognition, and album management. Foundation for ingestion pipelines (Google Photos, iCloud, Amazon) and future Iris photo analysis integration.
author: Ka'tuar'el / Mythos System
services_added: mythos-photos (systemd → docker compose: immich_server, immich_machine_learning, immich_redis, immich_postgres)
rollback: sudo systemctl stop mythos-photos && sudo systemctl disable mythos-photos && docker compose -f /opt/mythos/photos/docker-compose.yml down -v
